Title: Getting Started with Konbit Work Events API

Nodes.Text: Send proof of work (a merged pull request, a client's approval email, a finished calendar session) to your Konbit workspace. Claude reviews it, matches it to an open milestone and proposes a PayPal payout. Your signed mandate then decides: **auto** (paid with PayPal Payouts), **ask** (waits for your approval) or **block**.
Evidence is treated as untrusted text. It can never add a payee or raise a limit.
Send your workspace key in the `X-Konbit-Key` header. Create it in Konbit under **Mandate → Work-event webhook**. It is shown once.
The demo runs on the PayPal sandbox: no real money moves. Sign in at [petiht.com/freelanceragent](https://petiht.com/freelanceragent/) with `demo` / `Demo509`.
Send work evidence to the payout agent and read its decision.
The instance of the `WorkEventsController` class can be created using the API Client.

Nodes.Title: Submit Work Event
Nodes.Name: submitWorkEvent
Nodes.Description:
Stores the evidence, asks the Konbit agent (Claude) to review it, and returns the
review together with any payout plans it created. A plan's `decision` tells you
what the signed mandate allowed: `auto` (paid with PayPal Payouts), `ask`
(waiting for the freelancer's approval) or `block` (refused by policy).
